major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Your main cooldown: send it off cooldown as an offensive burst, since rage spent pulls it back to a 2-3 minute cycle, and only bank it when a known lethal window is coming.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 102558 is the cast id observed in the parse; the guide links 394786, which is the talent node.

major_cooldowns.name: Lunar Beam
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it with Incarnation whenever Incarnation is ready, otherwise only when Incarnation is more than 60 seconds out (30 with Lunation), and line it up with Red Moon if the two are close.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 204066 is the cast id that also carries the self aura; 204069, 414613 and 1270292 share the name.

major_cooldowns.name: Red Moon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Single-target only: cast it with Mangle off cooldown and no Red Moon already ticking, then keep hitting Mangle, since each Mangle extends it by 1 second and returns 8 rage.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1252871 is the cast id; 1253582 shares the name.

major_cooldowns.name: Sundering Roar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it once Thrash is at 3 or more stacks (4 with one point of Flashing Claws, 5 with two), so the Thrash reset and the extra 5 stacks land on a full bleed.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parse; the ability table verifies it as a real castable id.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it in Bear Form, and with Lunation hold it for Lunar Beam being active or more than 15 seconds away.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parse; the ability table verifies it as a real castable id.

major_cooldowns.name: Heart of the Wild
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Shift to Cat Form every 2 minutes and cast it there for the single-target damage-over-time, switching to Moonkin Form only on pulls of 6 or more.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1261867 is the verified castable id; the guide's catweaving section links 319454.

major_cooldowns.name: Wild Guardian
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Available after each Berserk or Incarnation: spend it while Ravage is up, or inside Lunar Beam when you are not playing Ravage.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1269658 is the cast id granted by Incarnation; 1269616 is its aura and 1269619 the talent node. Cooldown tracks Incarnation, which grants it.

major_cooldowns.name: Bristling Fur
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it into incoming damage while Mangle and Thrash are both on cooldown and rage is under 40 (60 with Killing Blow), never while Ravage is up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parse; the ability table verifies it as a real castable id.

rule.description: Raze at high rage for Harnessed Rage
rule.action: Dump rage into Raze above 80 rage: Harnessed Rage doubles its chance to proc Gore, which resets Mangle and feeds the whole loop.

rule.description: Mangle only below the rage cap
rule.action: Spend into Raze or Ironfur before pressing Mangle above 88 rage (83 with Soul of the Forest) so its 10 to 15 rage is not thrown away.
Send Lunar Beam with Incarnation when Incarnation is ready; otherwise only burn it while Incarnation is more than 60 seconds away (30 with Lunation).
Only cast Red Moon with Mangle off cooldown and nothing already ticking, then Mangle straight away: every Mangle extends it by 1 second and returns 8 rage.

rule.description: Heart of the Wild in Cat Form
rule.action: Rake out of Bear Form to shift to Cat, cast Heart of the Wild there for the single-target damage-over-time, then Mangle to shift straight back; Moonkin Form is only for pulls of 6 or more.
